title: Bring a better brief to the hunt
goal: Help readers understand the conversation, then invite them to express interest in Tix. Measure confirmed waitlist submissions after collection and tracking are verified.
schedule_note: Proposed dates: 14–25 September 2026, America/New_York. Nothing is scheduled. Move this calendar to the actual launch window after human review.

slots.title: Introduce the buying conversation
slots.angle: Use the complete article to explain the Sony brief, the personal limit and the product direction.
slots.gate: Approve article and verify the destination before CMS handoff.

slots.title: Explain the preview
slots.angle: Give returning readers the short account of what the preview demonstrates and what is planned next.
slots.gate: Confirm preview release state and approve the entry.

slots.title: Introduce Tix in motion
slots.angle: Use the accepted short animation as the visual introduction.
slots.audience: Visitors to the intended entry surface
slots.gate: Creative approved. Login aspect ratio, crop, muted behavior and HTML CTA integration still require packaging.

slots.title: Connect the product to the reader's work
slots.angle: Choose the SMB equipment, agency shoot or reseller evaluation variant from verified audience fields.
slots.audience: Opted-in leads, one mutually exclusive segment each
slots.gate: Approve each variant, map a real audience and configure the ESP footer. Do not infer a partner program.

slots.title: Write the buying brief
slots.angle: Use the agency equipment example as a practical prompt readers can adapt.
slots.gate: Approve the written post and linked destination.

slots.title: Dinner with Tix
slots.angle: Show the human moment that starts the buying conversation.
slots.gate: The 55-second 1080p master is approved. Create and review a ≤30-second social version and platform crop before this placement.

slots.title: Invite the first brief
slots.angle: Show the conversation graphic when the reader opens product updates.
slots.audience: Eligible viewers who request the announcement
slots.gate: Approve graphic and copy. Bind to real targeting and respect dismissal; suppress people already enrolled.

slots.title: What the price comparison means
slots.angle: Explain the role of the buyer's own limit in the preview.
slots.gate: Approve the exact post and destination.

slots.title: Bring a real equipment need
slots.angle: Use the SMB or agency exercise to help readers form their own request.
slots.audience: Verified returning preview readers; required customer labels are test contexts
slots.gate: Verify audience relationship before mapping customer segments. Suppress confirmed waitlist members from this acquisition CTA.

slots.title: Ask what would change the decision
slots.angle: Invite specific buyer input about the details of a used-camera brief.
slots.audience: Secondhand buyers with a current purchase in mind
slots.gate: Approve the exact post. Review replies manually.

slots.title: Learn from the first response
slots.angle: Review confirmed signups, source-tagged visits and the questions people ask. Use actual results to plan the next piece.
slots.gate: No results or conversion targets are claimed. Collect evidence only after a real launch.

social_drafts.text:
The next client shoot needs a camera. Before anyone starts browsing, write down the buying brief.

“I'm in Brooklyn, looking for a used Sony camera for less than $950.”

That sentence gives the search a place to begin. You can add the model you have in mind or explain whether a lens needs to be included.

Tix is being built around this kind of conversation. Its preview compares an asking price with the buyer's chosen limit, while supported marketplace sources are part of the next stage.

Think about the next piece of equipment you'd buy used. What would you put in that first message?

Join the waitlist: tixmancer.xyz

A camera can fit your $950 budget and still need a closer look.

Tix's preview compares an asking price with your own limit. Assessing market value needs separate evidence.

Join the waitlist: tixmancer.xyz

You're looking for a used Sony in Brooklyn, with $950 as your limit. Which detail would you ask about first?

I'd start with what comes with the camera. A lens description can change the whole buying question.

Tix is being built to start that secondhand hunt with a conversation about what you need.

Join the waitlist: tixmancer.xyz
